activity.notes: Karl XII reigned as King of Sweden from 1697 until his death at Fredriksten in 1718. ATLAS records the conventional continuous sovereign reign at year granularity.

sources.title: The monarchy of Sweden — The Royal Court of Sweden
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court of Sweden lists Karl XII as reigning from 1697 to 1718.

sources.title: Monarkins historia — Kungahuset
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court describes Karl XII's reign and records his death at Fredriksten in 1718.
